description: Create superhero or supervillain codenames — adjective + noun combos with a matching superpower, hero or villain leaning.

faqs.a: Hero names use bright, bold word banks; villain names switch to dark, ominous banks with menace-themed powers.
faqs.q: What changes with the villain toggle?

faqs.a: Each codename comes with a suggested superpower like flight, telekinesis, or shadow manipulation.
Click any codename or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a result?

howto: Pick how many codenames to generate.
Press Generate, then click any result to copy it.
title: Superhero Name Generator
